notes.title: Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
This should make it a lot easier for me to see bug reports in the future.
Whenever you have an issue, email lonely.tribes@gmail.com, with the log.txt file in the local files, in the assets folder, with instructions on how you made my game break.

Also, this version added support for csv maps, but there aren't any yet, but this should make it easier for me in the future to upload more maps. :D
